== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Rebel Tech (Japanese)|Rebel Tech]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/164793246/lq23Xv-qB0aoC0nsfAzXnQ.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 164793246.

Crop rectangle <code>(262, 1119, 2330, 4008)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>c8eb107250b82d0290dfd2721b2eb11edb7e337475ce6b1fa177782d72766709</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
